baseline_models.focus_anchor: `ta'bud` at word 3, repeated `al-shaytan` at words 4 and 6, and `kana li-l-Rahman asiyyan` at words 7-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prohibition sets up an authority paradox: worship can be submissive obedience and enslavement, yet the proposed master is established as outside obedience to the Merciful. Serving him would reproduce his rebellious posture in the servant.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship makes the prohibited act an enacted allegiance, not merely an address to a named object.
Enslavement supplies the transfer-of-agency side of submitting to the proposed master.
The defiant rebel image identifies the one receiving allegiance as himself insubordinate.
Occurrence and presence in time frame the rebellion as an established relation rather than a momentary slip.
Tender mercy makes the authority being resisted beneficent rather than arbitrary.
Exit from obedience closes the paradox: the obeyed figure models refusal of obedience.

changed_reading.after: A warning that submission places the addressee under a rebel master and reproduces that master's refusal of the Merciful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The filial address at word 1 stands against the repeated Satan-name and the relational phrase `li-l-Rahman`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fatherhood and mercy supply care-bearing kinship, while the Satan branches supply distance and a long tether and the worship branch supplies a made-passable road. The warning can therefore carry worship as a practiced tether that draws a household relation into separation from its source of care.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and upbringing make the addressee a bearer and source of care.
The marked father-address keeps intimacy active inside the prohibition.
The leveled, passable road image makes repeated submission a path-forming practice.
Distance and severance supply the relational destination of that practice.
The long, tightly twisted rope supplies the tether by which distance can paradoxically be imposed.
Kinship makes separation from the Merciful also readable as damage to right relation.

changed_reading.before: A son gives his father a doctrinal prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The filial appeal warns that a practiced allegiance can pull a care-bearing kinship into severance from Mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The worshiped object in 19:42 is denied hearing, sight, and effective sufficiency; 19:44 then names Satan as the active diagnosis. This shifts Satan-worship from an overt cult directed at Satan to the hidden allegiance operating through devotion to an inert proxy.

activation_trace.role: Obedient submission allows worship of a visible object to enact allegiance beyond that object.
Understanding and compliance sharpen the negated hearing into an absence of responsive agency.
Inner sight sharpens the negated seeing into an absence of discernment.
Sufficiency makes the negated benefit a failure to provide any operative support.
Deviation and crookedness supply the concealed directional logic behind the inert proxy.

structural_cues: The three coordinated negations in 19:42 are followed by 19:43's counter-route and then 19:44's positive diagnosis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonresponsive objects and the later Satan-label; I infer that the label exposes a hidden allegiance rather than a new visible object. Alternatively, it may classify idol worship by its disobedient quality without implying hidden agency.

changed_reading.before: Do not perform direct worship of Satan.
changed_reading.after: Recognize that devotion to an unresponsive proxy can function as obedience to the deviant agency or logic named Satan.

context_deltas.mechanism: The chain follow me, I will guide you, a path, straight in 19:43 activates the focus images of a road made passable and a crooked deviation. Worship becomes a path-forming sequence of followership rather than a discrete ritual choice.

activation_trace.role: The leveled road image turns submission into the making and repeated use of a route.
Crooked deviation supplies the rival route's directional defect.
Following behind supplies the first movement by which a route becomes allegiance.
Gentle direction toward the true road supplies the offered counter-guidance.
The straight road makes the competing orientation spatially explicit.
Integrity and straightness qualify the offered route against Satanic crookedness.

structural_cues: 19:43 chains an imperative, promised guidance, a path, and its straight quality immediately before the prohibition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two lexical route complexes; I infer that repeated obedience lays down the route one inhabits. Alternatively, the road language may concern only Abraham's guidance offer and not the mechanics of worship.

changed_reading.before: The verse forbids one wrong devotional act.
changed_reading.after: The verse interrupts a rival route of followership before repeated submission makes crookedness the addressee's normal path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prospective sequence in 19:45 moves from a touching punishment to becoming Satan's wali. The focus act of submission is thereby exposed as a relational trajectory whose endpoint is no-gap proximity and Satanic governance, not an isolated performance.

activation_trace.role: Enslavement gives the focus act a trajectory toward loss of agency.
The long tether supplies a material link between repeated service and captured relation.
An effect making contact supplies the threshold event in the warning.
Painful punishment supplies the threatened consequence at that threshold.
Coming to be in time marks a transition into a new relational state.
Nearness without an intervening gap defines the endpoint as captured proximity.
Taking charge of an affair gives that proximity a governing function.

structural_cues: The `fa-takuna` sequence in 19:45 presents becoming a wali as a prospective consequence after the threatened touch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies touch, punishment, becoming, and wali proximity/governance; I infer a trajectory from worship into relational capture. Alternatively, wali may emphasize alliance or support, and the exact causal force of the sequence remains open.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a bounded act that can simply be stopped.
changed_reading.after: Worship is an attachment process that can harden into proximity to and governance by the one served.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father answers with threatened expulsion and commanded separation in 19:46, enacting the focus Satan-branch of distance inside the father-son bond. Abraham answers in 19:47 with peace, protective forgiveness, and attentive care, furnishing a counter-practice that refuses to mirror the severance he diagnoses.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance become a social pattern that the next reply can enact.
The intimate father-address keeps the threatened rupture inside a live kinship relation.
Cursing, driving out, and distancing materialize the father's threatened response.
Rupture and parting complete the enacted image of Satanic distance.
Peace-making supplies Abraham's non-retaliatory answer to threatened conflict.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer supplies a restorative alternative to expulsion.
Attentive kindness and honor link Abraham's response back to the Merciful mode.

structural_cues: The threat and separation imperative in 19:46 are immediately answered by peace and promised intercession in 19:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture followed by a peace-and-covering response; I infer that the dialogue performs Satanic severance and its merciful counter-pattern. Alternatively, the exchange may contrast temperaments without making the root image causal.

changed_reading.before: Satan's rebellion is an abstract fact supporting the prohibition.
changed_reading.after: Satanic rebellion becomes recognizable as a reproducible social practice of expelling corrective intimacy, while mercy resists copying that practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham's withdrawal from false worship is followed by gifts, mercy, descendants, and a brother. Against the focus opposition of fatherhood, mercy-kinship, and Satanic severance, the warning stands at a hinge where inherited kinship is painfully limited but care-bearing kinship is reconfigured rather than abolished.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and upbringing define the inherited relation placed under strain.
Severance supplies the cost imposed by incompatible allegiance.
Withdrawal to one side makes the relational boundary an enacted choice.
A gift without exchange begins the replacement side of the sequence.
Merciful kinship makes the gifts relational rather than merely compensatory goods.
Brotherhood supplies a concrete new bond within the mercy-gift pattern.

structural_cues: The `fa-lamma` sequence in 19:49 places divine gift after withdrawal, and 19:50-53 repeat mercy and newly given family relations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal followed by gifted and merciful relations; I infer a reconfiguration of kinship around allegiance. Alternatively, the gifts need not be a transactional replacement for the father's rejection.

changed_reading.before: The son must choose correct worship despite disagreement with his father.
changed_reading.after: The warning marks a costly boundary in inherited kinship while leaving open a mercy-grounded reconstitution of belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later household exemplar persistently commands family toward prayer and purification and is approved, while the guided descendants respond to the Merciful's recited signs by falling, prostrating, and weeping. This creates a positive counter-lineage: filial order is not rejected, but authority is tested by whether it directs embodied submission toward the Merciful or reproduces rebellion.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and upbringing make intergenerational direction part of the focus problem.
Submissive worship supplies the allegiance that household authority can direct well or badly.
Departure from obedience supplies the negative relational endpoint.
Repeated temporal presence frames household command and approval as settled character.
Binding direction supplies the positive use of authority within a family.
The belonging-group places that command inside intimate social responsibility.
Obligatory prayer supplies the rightly directed form of worship.
Purification and rectification make household worship ethically productive.
Obedience, love, and assurance mark the household guide as accepted rather than rebellious.
Gentle guidance links the descendants' response to the straight counter-route.
Following and succession make recitation both sequence and transmission.
Lowering in humility provides the bodily opposite of rebellious refusal.
Grief, tears, and voice provide the affective sign of responsive submission.

structural_cues: 19:55 repeats `kana` around household command and approval; 19:58 chains recitation into falling, prostration, and weeping while repeating `al-Rahman`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a household commander approved by his Lord and descendants bodily responding to the Merciful; I infer these as a counter-lineage to the focus rebellion. Alternatively, the later exemplars may broaden the catalogue of prophets without directly specifying the father-son dispute.

changed_reading.before: The son's prohibition appears to overturn filial hierarchy in favor of private conviction.
changed_reading.after: The son audits filial authority by its direction: valid kinship forms responsive worship of the Merciful, whereas inherited authority cannot legitimate obedience to rebellion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the womb and weaning branches of mercy and punishment; it remains anchored because `al-Rahman` and enslaving worship are in the focus and 19:45 joins touch, punishment, and Satanic proximity. Downstream prose must render it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical meaning of mercy or punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `ta'bud al-shaytan` and `al-Rahman` in 19:44, carried into the touch, punishment, and Satanic wali sequence of 19:45.

activation_trace.role: Enslavement supplies the dependency from which separation would be painful.
The long tether gives that dependency a material attachment image.
The womb supplies a containing, generative image for mercy.
An effect making contact supplies the felt interruption of attachment.
Restraint, prevention, and weaning supply the exploratory detachment image.
Nearness without a gap defines the attachment that the warning seeks to prevent.

changed_reading.before: Punishment from the Merciful is only a retributive consequence external to the worship relation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its touch can also be carried as a painful merciful weaning from enslaving attachment before Satanic proximity closes.

strongest_changes: 19:42 turns direct Satan-worship into hidden allegiance operating through inert cult objects.
19:43 and the focus road/deviation branches recast worship as path-forming followership.
19:45 exposes worship's endpoint as proximity to and governance by Satan.
19:46-58 turn the warning into an intergenerational authority test: severance and capture versus merciful, responsive worship.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated father-address and `al-Rahman` let distance, kinship, enslavement, path, household command, and embodied response form several traceable mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 19:45's `fa-takuna` makes punishment causally produce Satanic alliance or marks the culmination of prior worship remains open.
The distance/tether and womb/weaning readings are branch-image activations, not lexical replacements.
The later prophetic exemplars may function as contrastive orientation rather than direct specification of 19:44.
